sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto with ya and todavía no to describe a recent boat trip. Talk about completed experiences and activities that have not happened yet.

items.spanish: Ya hemos visto lugares muy bonitos.
items.english: We have already seen very beautiful places.

items.spanish: Todavía quiero probar más comida típica.
items.english: I still want to try more typical food.

items.spanish: Las vacaciones han empezado de la mejor manera posible.
items.english: The holidays have started in the best possible way.

sections.content: Keep the auxiliary and participle together. Use ya for completed actions and todavía no for actions that have not happened yet.
